BDD tree density: detailed (default, roll-ups on folders) or compact (less duplicate roll-ups).
Less duplicate roll-ups: global summary row, structural folder labels, outcomes on leaves only.
Default layout: roll-up on every folder and tinted container icons (v1.3 behavior).
bddPilot.configuration.tree.groupBy.desc: How scenarios are organized in the BDD Pilot test tree.
bddPilot.configuration.tree.groupBy.enum: Group by Gherkin @tag — QA smoke/regression suites.
bddPilot.configuration.tree.tagDisplay.d: How scenario and feature tags appear in the BDD Pilot test tree.
bddPilot.configuration.tree.tagDisplay.e: Do not show tags in the tree (tags still appear in the hover tooltip).
Show a short summary such as "6 tags" instead of listing every @tag.
Show up to N tags, then "+M" for the rest (see compactTagLimit).
List every @tag in the description (can truncate on narrow panels).
bddPilot.configuration.tree.durationDisp: How test run durations appear in the tree description.
Readable unit by magnitude: 450 ms, 2.3 s, 2m 15s. Hover shows exact ms.
bddPilot.configuration.filter.outlineRow: How clicking Run on an outline row builds the dotnet test filter.
Run a single Scenario Outline row via VSTest DisplayName~ (Reqnroll/xUnit Theory).
Run the whole Scenario Outline / Theory method (all example rows).
bddPilot.configuration.feedback.postRunT: Unified post-run notification with pass/fail counts, optional diagnostic hint, and quick actions.
One unified toast when tests failed or the run did not complete (counts plus actionable hint when available).
Always show one unified post-run toast with pass/fail counts after every completed run.
bddPilot.configuration.outcomes.rehydrat: Restore tree and Test Explorer outcomes from the latest Pilot TRX file when opening the workspace.
Restore pass/fail icons from the latest BDD Pilot TRX in TestResults/ when the extension activates (if no outcomes in this session yet).
Do not restore outcomes from disk on activate.
bddPilot.configuration.tree.searchRunCap: When running filtered tests, ask for confirmation if more than this many scenarios match (0 = never ask).
bddPilot.configuration.locale.descriptio: Language for BDD Pilot status bar, dashboard, CodeLens, and dialogs. Auto follows VS Code UI language.
bddPilot.configuration.locale.enum.auto: Follow VS Code UI language (Spanish UI → Spanish).
bddPilot.configuration.defaultStage.desc: Default environment (STAGE) used when running tests. Loads optional config/.env.<stage> (and .local overlays).
bddPilot.configuration.defaultStage.enum: Development — local env; usually no confirmation.
Test — default recommended STAGE for day-to-day runs.
Staging — typically requires confirmation before run.
Production — typically requires confirmation before run.
bddPilot.configuration.defaultMode.descr: Default xUnit test-collection parallelism (hub Mode). Not the same as Debug session / dashboard runKind.
Serial collections (xunit.parallelizeTestCollections=false) — easiest to step through failures.
CI-oriented parallelism profile for multi-core hosts.
bddPilot.configuration.security.allowPro: Allow STAGE=prod runs. When false (default), production is blocked; when true, the existing production confirmation modal still applies.
bddPilot.configuration.statusBar.display: Status bar layout: compact (single branded hub, default) or detailed (legacy four items).
Single BDD Pilot hub with stage, mode, and project.
Legacy layout with separate STAGE, mode, running, and project items.
bddPilot.configuration.preRun.bindingGat: Before dotnet test, check step bindings via BDD Guardian resolveStep (requires anghelll.bdd-guardian v0.8.3+).
Disabled — same behavior as before v1.5.
Log ambiguous bindings to Output; notify (non-modal) for unbound — Run anyway or Cancel.
Block runs with missing (unbound) bindings; ambiguous bindings still allow run anyway.
bddPilot.configuration.run.configuration: Optional dotnet test --configuration (Debug or Release). Empty omits the flag (project default).
bddPilot.configuration.run.noBuild.descr: When true, pass --no-build to dotnet test (skip build; requires a prior successful build).
bddPilot.configuration.run.runSettings.d: Path to a .runsettings file (workspace-relative or absolute). Passed as dotnet test --settings when the file exists.
bddPilot.configuration.diagnostics.exten: Enable extended post-run diagnostics (cloud credentials, X-Ray, API HTTP errors). Off by default for generic Marketplace projects.
bddPilot.configuration.feedback.diagnost: How much of the BDD Pilot diagnostics block to append to the Output channel after a run.
Do not append Pilot diagnostics (dotnet log unchanged).
One-line summary of the top diagnostic (+N more when applicable).
bddPilot.configuration.ai.enabled.descri: Enable the Copy Failure Context for AI command (clipboard-only; no LLM calls).
bddPilot.configuration.ai.contextMaxOutp: Maximum lines of sanitized test output included in the AI failure context package.
bddPilot.configuration.ai.rehydrateFromT: After Reload, rebuild Copy for AI context from the latest Pilot TRX (same age/history gates as outcome rehydrate). May not match current code — review before sharing.
